description: This file contains client-side JavaScript code for a website, managing UI interactions such as menu toggling, skills accordion, modal dialogs, swiper slider, scroll-based navigation highlighting, header background change, scroll-up button, and theme toggling.

methods.name: linkAction
methods.description: Removes 'show-menu' class from navigation menu when a navigation link is clicked.

methods.name: toggleSkills
methods.description: Toggles the skills content between open and closed states when a skills header is clicked.

methods.name: modal
methods.description: Activates a modal dialog based on the index provided.

methods.name: scrollActive
methods.description: Highlights the navigation link corresponding to the currently viewed section based on scroll position.

methods.name: scrollHeader
methods.description: Changes the header background when scrolling past a certain point.

methods.name: scrollUp
methods.description: Shows or hides the scroll-up button based on scroll position.

methods.name: getCurrentTheme
methods.description: Returns the current theme ('dark' or 'light') based on the body's class list.

methods.name: getCurrentIcon
methods.description: Returns the current icon class ('uil-moon' or 'uil-sun') based on the theme button's class list.
